profiles.name: AshliAngel
profiles.summary: AshliAngel describes an approach that combines mediumship, tarot and relationship guidance, with particular attention to heartbreak and reconciliation.
profiles.about: On her public Kasamba profile, AshliAngel describes herself as an empathic clairvoyant. She says she works with mediumship, tarot and angel-themed readings and focuses on questions about love and life direction. These are her own descriptions of her practice, not independently verified credentials or outcomes.
